steps.en: Install the package on an Apple-silicon Mac
steps.zh: 在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上装好这个包

steps.en: Load a model by Hugging Face repo id, usually a pre-quantized mlx-community one
steps.zh: 按 Hub 仓库名加载模型，常用 mlx-community 量化版

steps.en: Downloads weights and tokenizer from the Hub and caches them on disk
steps.zh: 从 Hub 下载权重和分词器，缓存到本地磁盘

steps.en: Builds the architecture in MLX and loads weights into memory shared by CPU and GPU
steps.zh: 用 MLX 搭好模型结构，把权重装进 CPU 和 GPU 共用的内存

steps.en: Apply the chat template and ask it to generate
steps.zh: 套上对话模板，调用生成

steps.en: Runs the prompt on the Apple GPU and returns tokens, reusing a KV cache
steps.zh: 在苹果 GPU 上跑提示并输出 token，复用 KV 缓存

value.en: A Hugging Face model runs on your Mac from plain Python — no GGUF conversion, no separate server
value.zh: Hugging Face 模型直接用 Python 在 Mac 上跑起来，不用转 GGUF，也不用另起服务

sources: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm#readme (pip install mlx-lm; Python API: load, apply_chat_template, generate; mlx-community models)
